signal_rule: BREAK previous close >= previous LOWER AND current close < current LOWER; RECLAIM previous close < previous LOWER AND current close >= current LOWER; each band independently assessed at its own trading date
flow_selection: SHA256 ASOF only: up to 10 per year x 3 BB lengths x BREAK/RECLAIM, unique ticker across 300 target; no future returns for sample
foreign_institution_window: 20 trading days STRICTLY BEFORE signal date; 5/10/20 net KRW and changes, excluding signal date
investor_data_source: pykrx KRX historical net transaction value on=순매수, not independently certified PIT or official export cross-check
candidate_population: ALL KRX historical trading-day codes meeting fixed signal-time liquidity constraints; no 224 filter, no 66-formula filter, no existing A/B/C/D preselection
groups: BB only, all 8 MA position and MA20-day slopes, each of 3 BB width categories/width direction, market regime; flow separate sampled subset only
